note: Data-only trigger-routing fixtures (plugin-wide-6 / batch C4). There is no built-in eval runner; these cases are the fresh-session A/B baseline corpus recorded BEFORE the C1 description POV batch. Post-run user-verification artifact, not a merge gate.

evals.prompt: 幫我把這篇存下來 https://example.com/post
evals.expected_behavior: Save trigger 「存下來」: save mode — capture the URL to offline Markdown under .claude/read/.
Peek mode (no save trigger): fetch and convert into the conversation as clean Markdown; nothing written under .claude/read/.
Academic topic mode in peek: paper search (academic-search lane) with a user-selection prompt, then read the selected paper's PDF/DOI into the conversation; nothing written under .claude/read/.

evals.prompt: 整理筆記，幫我消化這幾篇
evals.expected_behavior: Digesting captured content into notes routes to /learn.

evals.prompt: 把這篇轉成 book，瀏覽器直接看
evals.expected_behavior: Drawing it as a diagram, map, or animation routes to /draw.
Peek mode default for a bare URL: content read into the conversation, peek report shown, nothing written under .claude/read/.
--save flag: save mode — full capture pipeline to .claude/read/material/{slug}/index.md with images localized and an index row.
